ThinkByte: Harsha Thota, Mahesh Patil, Vigarna Ramesh
Key Takeaways
Evaluated digital marketing strategies, focusing on influencer campaigns and ad creative updates; discussed Shopify integration issues for better tracking.
Decided to pause underperforming Swiggy and Nutrition Week static image campaigns due to low CTR and sales; reallocated budgets to more effective influencer efforts.
Action items included updating the marketing summary sheet, creating new ad sets for varied audiences, and assessing the effectiveness of the Nutrition Week retargeting.
Identified significant communication issues, such as poor audibility and screen sharing difficulties, emphasizing the need for better meeting protocols and technology.
Planned to monitor adjusted campaigns closely, with a follow-up meeting scheduled to review progress and resolve outstanding issues.
